detail: tests.test_native_heap_from_profile.HeapFromProfileTests.test_a_profile_the_machine_cannot_hold_is_refused_by_name_at_start. In this lane's world (lane memory-run-launch @839d46e10, hbox native-m28-2g-b) the first scale start refuses 'capacity=0 of 31 bound-by=over-window': the slot's second place, where the OVER window term leaves room for one. In OVER's world (lane/over @5cd18fd28, hbox native-l2-o8-3) the launcher refuses 'machine-cannot-hold-profile heap=17726 MB machine=2048 MB sized by the offline adapter (pre-payload-only figure, under-bounds the store): header totals unseen'. That is the offline-adapter sizing L-RUN-LAUNCH replaces elsewhere, still reached on this path. Retired when the pre-launch sizing reads the run's derived capacity, or when the test drives the pressure through a live reconfigure (statement-first; M).
